root_cause: QEMU 2.12 fork: (1) hvf_arch_set_traps(...,true) enable path ABSENT (set_trap_debug_* only ever false); (2) HVF guest-debug plumbing (hvf_arch_insert_hw_breakpoint/update_guest_debug) ABSENT; (3) QEMU 2.12 predates AccelOpsClass, so gdb_breakpoint_insert -> cpu_breakpoint_insert -> TCG tb_invalidate_phys_addr -> uninitialized mutex under HVF -> fatal. NOT an Apple HVF limitation (debug APIs imported & documented).
tcg_via_launcher: NOT_VIABLE: `-qemu -accel tcg` (and with -cpu max) makes qemu die at startup (accel conflict vs emulator-injected HVF machine config); abort goes to crashpad.
upstream_fix: QEMU 8.1.0 commit eb2edc42 (+0ca52a5), Francesco Cagnin/Quarkslab; ~520 new HVF lines. Backport feasibility MEDIUM; hard part = 2.12 gdbstub-dispatch intercept (pre-AccelOpsClass).
asid_caveat: Upstream HW breakpoints are unlinked address-match (BT=0, no ASID/VMID). A userspace VA (libea56+0x13a4bc) BP fires for ANY process at that VA -> disambiguate host-side via TTBR0_EL1/CONTEXTIDR_EL1 read on each stop (sysreg reads already work under HVF).
